description.zh:
订阅的应用ID。
> 应用ID由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大64字符。
description.en:
The application ID.

> The ID can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh:
自定义SEI。
> 自定义SEI为json字符串，不超过4096个字符。
description.en:
The custom SEI.

> The value is a JSON string that can be up to 4,096 characters in length.

description.zh:
任务ID。
> 任务ID由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大55字符。
description.en:
The task ID.

> The ID can be up to 55 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
本接口用于设置混流转推任务的自定义SEI信息。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
## [](#)Usage notes

You can call this operation to configure custom SEI for a mixed-stream relay task.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live set-live-mpu-task-sei --app-id yourAppId --task-id yourTaskId --custom-sei key_:_value --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live SetLiveMpuTaskSei --region cn-hangzhou --TaskId yourTaskId --AppId yourAppId --CustomSei 'key_:_value'
